messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — TerraFirma wants to run a 48h pilot in SA. They need a temporary rate bump and an egress allowlist so their infra team can run tests.

sam_account_manager: pls confirm window, qps, and CIDR. any renewal flags?

maria_cs: Window: 2026-03-25T14:00Z -> 2026-03-27T14:00Z. Target qps: 15 (spiky). Source CIDR: 200.123.45.0/24. Rough token estimate ~80k tokens/day. Renewal is at EoQ, flagged as at-risk until pilot shows stability.

infradev_tom: Ok. We can provision in sa-east1 and attach a temp policy with auto-revoke. Two quick checks: 1) do they need dedicated nodes? 2) will they accept slightly higher p95?

maria_cs: They do not need dedicated nodes for pilot, just a soft bump. p95 tolerance: up to +50ms.

capacity_bot: [auto] INC-8742 created for TF-99221 - TEMP-RLIFT request. Expiry set to 2026-03-27T14:00Z. Assigned: infra-provisioning.

dev_rel_lee: Suggest enabling prefix/KV caching for their chat flows to reduce token spend and keep costs predictable — low friction on our side. cc: ops for rollout.

infradev_tom: I'll apply this config. draft below — please confirm before I push:

```
policy: temp_rate_bump_tf_99221
region: sa-east1
qps: 15
cidr_allowlist:
  - 200.123.45.0/24
auto_revoke: 2026-03-27T14:00Z
enable_prefix_cache: true
notes: pilot smoke tests only; revoke if abnormal error rate >1%
```

sam_account_manager: confirm. also add a CRM note about renewal risk and request a brief ROI/feedback doc after pilot — we need evidence to reduce churn.

maria_cs: will do. adding ROI template to the ticket and will collect feedback from their engineering lead.

infradev_tom: provisioning started. I'll post route & firewall details when ready. ETA ~12min.

maria_cs: route active at 2026-03-25T14:12Z. doing smoke tests now.

maria_cs: smoke tests OK. p95 latency in sa-east1 rose from ~160ms to ~190ms, customer accepts. no errors observed.

dev_rel_lee: nice. I'll follow up with a short enablement doc for TerraFirma's devs and add a note to docs backlog for a self-serve pattern.

maria_cs: Feedback capture plan: send 3-question post-pilot survey + short call. I'll attach results to INC-8742. :thumbsup:

infradev_tom: Change is auto-scheduled to revoke 2026-03-27T14:00Z. If we need an extension, reopen the ticket with justification.

capacity_bot: [auto] TEMP-RLIFT-TF-99221 will auto-revoke at 2026-03-27T14:00Z unless ticket updated.
